security_audit.summary: Most Markdown backtick and system reconnaissance findings are false positives from documentation formatting and normal error handling. The real risks are outbound BrowserAct network calls, execution of a bundled Python script, and unsafe guidance that invites users to share API keys in chat. The skill also frames Amazon automation around avoiding CAPTCHA and IP restrictions, which raises abuse and compliance concerns.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that ask users to provide BROWSERACT_API_KEY in chat. Require an environment variable or approved secret manager.
Remove claims about avoiding CAPTCHA and IP restrictions. Add rate limits and require users to confirm permitted data collection.
Document that keywords, brand filters, task metadata, and authorization headers are sent to BrowserAct before execution.
Validate page count as a bounded integer before sending it to the BrowserAct workflow.

content.user_title: Extract Amazon Product Data with BrowserAct
content.value_statement: Amazon research can require many manual searches and inconsistent notes. This skill launches a BrowserAct workflow to collect structured product signals for review.
actual_capabilities: Launches a BrowserAct workflow for Amazon product searches.
Accepts keyword, brand, page count, and language inputs.
Uses BROWSERACT_API_KEY from the environment for authorization.
Polls BrowserAct task status with timestamped progress messages.
Defines product fields such as ASIN, price, rating, brand, and attributes.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct API key and network access to BrowserAct.
The current script returns after polling, so result retrieval needs a code fix before reliable output.
It relies on BrowserAct and Amazon availability, including regional restrictions.
It does not validate page count or enforce rate limits.

use_cases.title: Compare Product Listings
use_cases.description: Review prices, ratings, ASINs, and featured badges for products matching a keyword and brand.

use_cases.title: Monitor Competitor Prices
use_cases.description: Collect product signals for a competitor brand before preparing pricing or assortment reports.

use_cases.title: Prepare Catalog Research
use_cases.description: Gather structured product identifiers and attributes for enrichment workflows and manual verification.

prompt_templates.title: Search One Brand
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Amazon Product API skill to search for Sony wireless earbuds in English. Use one page and summarize titles, ASINs, prices, and ratings.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Amazon for laptop stands from Anker and Belkin. Compare visible price ranges, ratings, ASINs, and featured badges.

prompt_templates.title: Track Category Signals
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect Amazon search results for reusable water bottles across two pages. Focus on brands, current prices, rating counts, and material attributes.

prompt_templates.title: Build Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a focused Amazon product search for noise cancelling headphones. Confirm the API key is stored in the environment, limit pages, and produce a research brief.

output_examples.input: Search for Apple laptops on one English results page.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports task start, timestamped polling updates, and completion status. A corrected retrieval flow should then summarize titles, ASINs, prices, and ratings.

output_examples.input: Compare Samsung wireless earbuds for market research.
output_examples.output: The assistant returns a concise product comparison with brand names, visible price ranges, rating counts, and featured badges when available.

output_examples.input: Find high-rated standing desks for catalog enrichment.
output_examples.output: The assistant highlights product identifiers, current prices, review signals, and attributes such as material or style for manual review.

best_practices: Store the BrowserAct API key in an environment variable or secret manager.
Limit page counts and confirm that the data collection is permitted.
Review status logs and verify important product data against Amazon before use.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into prompts, shared chats, or issue trackers.
Do not run high-volume searches without rate limits and authorization checks.
Do not treat extracted prices or ratings as final without freshness checks.

faq.question: What does this skill search?
faq.answer: It starts a BrowserAct Amazon product workflow using keywords, brand, page count, and language inputs.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It expects BROWSERACT_API_KEY to be configured before the script runs.

faq.question: Can I paste the key into chat?
faq.answer: No. Use an environment variable or approved secret manager instead.

faq.question: What product fields are described?
faq.answer: The skill describes titles, ASINs, product URLs, brands, prices, ratings, badges, color, material, and style.

faq.question: Does it work across languages?
faq.answer: It accepts a language input for the BrowserAct workflow, such as English, German, or Chinese.

faq.question: What should I verify before publishing results?
faq.answer: Verify freshness, regional availability, rate limits, and permission to collect the target data.
